summary: Example task backs up the Dell OS9 config with os9_config backup: yes.
questions: How do I back up a Dell OS9 switch config?

answer_card.title: Back up Dell OS9 config
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Backup current switch config (dellos9)
  dellemc.os9.os9_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_dellos9_location
  when: ansible_network_os == 'dellemc.os9.os9'
```
